scope: PO, GRN, invoice inputs; isolated local source probes only

findings.title: Saved GRN cannot be corrected when different lines share a SKU
findings.trigger: Import Enterprise Server A and Enterprise Server B, create/approve PO, save a receipt discrepancy, reopen receipt.

observed.saveError: SKU, jumlah, atau kondisi barang tidak sesuai dengan PO.

findings.impact: The second line is relabelled with the first line name and the unchanged reopened receipt is rejected; correcting or completing receipt is blocked.
findings.remedy: Preserve line-position/line-ID identity when reopening receipts; generate collision-safe imported identifiers.

findings.title: Invoice response is applied after source text has changed
findings.trigger: Start extracting quote A, replace textarea with quote B while request is pending, then let A response resolve and press Apply.

request.text: Quote A, vendor A, Enterprise Server A

observed.currentText: Quote B, vendor B, different products

findings.impact: PO receives vendor/items from the old quote even though the current invoice text contains another quote.
findings.remedy: Invalidate pending requests using a generation/source token when source text changes, or disable source editing during extraction.

findings.title: Invoice extraction accepts fractional quantities that the PO form cannot submit
findings.trigger: An extracted invoice contains qty 1.5 with a consistent subtotal.

observed.rejectedPOError: Jumlah, harga, atau subtotal barang tidak konsisten.

findings.impact: Extraction reports success and can populate the form, but creation fails until the user manually corrects the imported quantity.
findings.remedy: Align accepted invoice quantity rules with PO rules, or consistently support fractional units throughout.
